# ResumeInTwo

> Free resume maker. No prompt. No login. Just resume.

ResumeInTwo is a free web app that builds a professional resume in about 2 minutes: pick a field template, fill the form, preview live, and download a clean black-and-white A4 PDF. It includes an ATS score check and works without any login or chat.

- Website: https://resumeintwo.netlify.app/
- Features: 10 field templates, live form preview, A4 PDF download, ATS score check
- Tech: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Supabase, Netlify
- Price: Free
